import sys
import random

def gen():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) != 3:
        sys.exit(1)
    SEED = int(args[0])
    SIZE = int(args[1])
    MODE = args[2]

    rng = random.Random(SEED)

    # Determine n (1..12) and a (1..200) based on SIZE
    # Scale n and a roughly with SIZE
    n_min, n_max = 1, 12
    a_min, a_max = 1, 200

    # map SIZE 1..30 to ranges
    n = rng.randint(n_min, min(n_max, 1 + SIZE // 3))
    a = rng.randint(a_min, min(a_max, 20 + SIZE * 6))

    # Generate coin values
    coins = [1]
    if MODE == "tiny_values":
        # allow many small values, possible duplicates (will be deduped later)
        while len(coins) < n:
            # small range, include zeros which will be filtered out
            val = rng.randint(0, 5)
            if val == 0:
                continue
            coins.append(val)
    elif MODE == "normal":
        # spread values up to a reasonable bound
        max_val = min(a, 200)
        while len(coins) < n:
            # ensure increasing
            prev = coins[-1]
            # choose next between prev+1 and max_val
            hi = max(prev + 1, max_val - (n - len(coins)) + 1)
            lo = prev + 1
            val = rng.randint(lo, hi)
            coins.append(val)
    elif MODE == "extreme":
        # push to bounds, include negative where allowed (none here, but keep logic)
        while len(coins) < n:
            # choose either 1 or max possible
            if rng.random() < 0.5:
                val = rng.randint(1, 1)  # will be 1, later filtered
            else:
                val = rng.randint(1, 200)
            if val <= coins[-1]:
                val = coins[-1] + 1
            if val > 200:
                val = 200
            coins.append(val)
    else:
        sys.exit(1)

    # Ensure strictly increasing and within bounds
    # Remove duplicates and sort, then pad if needed
    coins = sorted(set(coins))
    # guarantee first is 1
    if coins[0] != 1:
        coins[0] = 1
    # fill up to n
    while len(coins) < n:
        last = coins[-1]
        nxt = min(last + 1, 200)
        if nxt == last:
            break
        coins.append(nxt)
    # truncate if too many
    coins = coins[:n]

    # final safety clamp
    for i, v in enumerate(coins):
        if v < 1:
            coins[i] = 1
        if v > 200:
            coins[i] = 200
    # ensure increasing
    for i in range(1, len(coins)):
        if coins[i] <= coins[i-1]:
            coins[i] = coins[i-1] + 1
            if coins[i] > 200:
                coins[i] = 200

    # output
    print(f"{len(coins)} {a}")
    print(" ".join(map(str, coins)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    gen()
